mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals an imminent monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE below 5.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and high housing starts (HOUST) often precede economic slowdowns, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods with GDPC1 growth > 2% and HOUST above 850k.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it triggers expectations of Fed rate hikes, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recoveries, rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of post-recession recovery periods with RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong job growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals an economic contradiction that often precedes a slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE rise fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
